goal: Implement and test one common human diagnostic block for full and changed CLI checks using the ct-001 fake-backed diagnostic payload, including warning and JSON parity.
approach: Use the existing registered fake adapter subs/cli/src/explained-diagnostics.ts, contract interface and conformance suite; do not invent another provider or put domain reasoning in CLI. Extract a shared block formatter for header/message/Importer/Original/details/related roles/proposal with the fixed proposal label, called by both formatHuman and formatChangedHuman; format warnings once with pluralization and file list. Preserve the full output metadata, changed-check new marker, JSON fields and exit codes. For fake-backed fixtures, apply the fake at the report/delta boundary only where required for current tests, marking a clear replacement point for verification rather than leaving the fake on production after provider conformance. Update local CLI-created diagnostics with empty details/null proposal/related roles. Bind sc-009 and sc-010 via quick-mode steps against deterministic fake-backed reports and document what is fake versus real. Do not change contract or package/runner files.

scope.rationale: All implementation and step definitions belong in CLI; provider contract, fake and conformance files already exist, with no need for cross-module writes in this iteration.

completionEvidence: Both human forms render the identical ordered diagnostic block from the same composed finding; full/changed warnings are byte-identical including plurality and file names; CLI-produced non-import findings have empty details, null proposal and roles; JSON preserves the completed diagnostics under the same schema identities; fake-backed quick scenarios sc-009 and sc-010 pass and exit code semantics are unchanged.
